skill_name: Research and explain how blockchain-based networks can be used to solve the double spending problem.
workflow: Blockchain-based networks can be used to solve the double spending problem because of their distributed ledger technology. A blockchain is a decentralized system where all transactions are recorded in a publicly distributed ledger, making it impossible to perpetrate a double spend attack. In addition, a blockchain also prevents cheating by using cryptographic algorithms to secure the network and verify transactions.
